source.notes: Synthetic conversation state for mobile flight search.

expectedBehavior: Apply a new fare cap to the route and dates established earlier in the conversation.

metadata.reviewHint: The route and dates come from history; the fare cap comes from the latest utterance.

conversation.content: Find flights from Boston to Lisbon departing 2026-09-03 returning 2026-09-12 for 2 travelers
I found round-trip Boston to Lisbon options for September 3 through September 12.

notes: The latest utterance is incomplete without history.
Do not change the established route or travel dates.

source.notes: Synthetic search-results comparison command for flights.

expectedBehavior: Recognize that ordinal references point to visible flight result positions from the prior turn.

metadata.reviewHint: The result details are generic synthetic flights, not real inventory.

conversation.content: Show flights from LAX to Seoul on 2026-08-04
Result 1 departs 09:15 with one stop. Result 2 departs 13:40 nonstop. Result 3 departs 22:05 with one stop.

notes: Ordinal references should be carried over from visible results.
Generic result descriptions are enough context here.

expectedBehavior: Ask for clarification when more than one visible result matches the nonstop reference.

metadata.reviewHint: Participants can experiment by changing the assistant history to make the reference unique.

conversation.content: Search flights from Chicago to Miami on 2026-07-18
Result 1 departs 07:10 nonstop. Result 2 departs 12:30 with one stop. Result 3 departs 17:45 nonstop.

expected.clarificationQuestion: Do you mean the 7:10 AM nonstop or the 5:45 PM nonstop?
notes: The nonstop preference is explicit, but it does not identify one result.
This is borderline if the app normally opens the first matching result.

expectedBehavior: Sort the current flight result set by duration without changing the route or fare filters.

metadata.reviewHint: Sorting commands are good for separating intent from filters.

conversation.content: Find flights from Newark to Phoenix departing 2026-10-05 for 1 passenger
I found flight options from Newark to Phoenix for October 5.

notes: Sorting by duration is not the same as adding a fare cap.
The existing route should remain unchanged.
